title: Memory Mansions that are Portals
content: I don't know if anyone here is familiar with the term "memory mansion" - its supposed to be a method for recalling info by associating it with an object, and then placing that object for "storage" in a room in a building (mansion) that you visualize in your mind... or something to that effect. I've never personally done this technique - however - I HAVE visited a "memory mansion" on the flipside quite often as a child/teenager it wasn't one that I built though - it already existed. It's like the mallworld concept, except that I don't know if it's particular to my specific culture (American), or bloodline, or just region of the world. So here's the basics of it: I called mine 'The Dark Mansion" - because the colors are extremely muted, almost nonexistant in that realm. There is no sun, moon, or stars in the sky - it's just black, with a fine horizon line that shows a faint glow and 1 spot of 'lightness' that could be a sun, but it never moves, its always out of sight except for that spot of lightness on the horizon. The mansion is the only thing there - this is in some sort of in-between realm, clearly, and it looks very old-worldish... like the picture, but MUCH bigger, and made with larger stones then brick (greyish - maybe marble, maybe granite). Other then that, there is 1 road that winds all the way from over the horizon, to the front entryway of the building. You never see anyone while you're outside the building, either; but when you look out from the windows while inside, you can see a line of traffic of people coming in every sort of vehicle or animal transportation, to get dropped off in front of the mansion to enter. And everyone is coming for the grande Ball & Banquet. Whomever comes arrives with children; upon leaving their vehicles and walking up to the mansion, the parents or adults - who are always talking to each other excitedly by that point - suddenly become deaf, dumb & blind to the kids with them - as if they ceased to exist. Everyone catches on at some point and reacts differently to this; but its never pleasant... the kids try to voice their concerns, usually, not really understanding whats wrong, just that something is wrong and in that process discover that they can get no interaction from the grown-ups. They follow them inside, sometimes quietly and unsure, and watch as the adults walk into the ballroom/banquet hall... its quite beautiful. It's all golden lights and filled with the warm scents of food, champagne, live music (stringed and wind instruments) and conversations... but as the children approach the banquet doors, they sense the trap that it REALLY is, and back away in a panic before stepping over the banquet hall's threshold - the way you would back up from a large predator if you should turn to see it drooling & stalking you from only 2 yards away (imagine: hyperventalating, sweating profusely, crying & shaking uncontrollably... takes a good 20-30 mins to calm down, usually) And at that response - the doors close. Noone who goes in EVER comes out. Ever. Only the ones who can recognize the trap and avoid it stay free - and thats always the children. The doors only ever open for newcomers and the few rare kids who grieve the loss of their parents so much that they wish to join them, whatever the true nature of the trap is (because noone knows). They approach the doors alone, genuinely wishing to go in - that's the only way to get them to start to open again. Because in the presence of others who know what it is, it closes and stays that way... which protected a lot of kids, when they stayed in groups. So what is the mansion, beyond the initial Ballroom trap? I don't know... for the adults - death, apparently. Only the children have the option to be free, and to choose where to go and what to do. So we would explore, and it never ends in the variations the mansion produces for any one kid. You never know what you'll find in any room or down any hallway; and the mansion changes after a while, too, moving rooms around and growing random new wings or corridors. What was interesting is that each room was decorated differently, and had different objects inside it. After a while of getting comfortable with the new situation, we realized that if you liked the room, and closed the door and WAITED - there would be a shift of some kind. Like a change in air pressure that you could feel in your ears/head, or the colors would get brighter, or the air would be sweeter, or the gravity was slightly lighter - SOMETHING tactile, but subtle, would shift. And then, when you open the door again - you exit to THE ACTUAL WORLD/REALM that room existed in, beyond the Mansion. And we'd explore the new realm until we got the overwhelming feeling that we needed to return - which was like a pressure/warning in our chests. And like a homing beacon, we'd find our way back to that room via the push/pull we'd feel in our heart/chest, without being seen by others (it was like we were invisible going to or from a room - which you get used to after awhile & take for granted). And once everyone's back in, the door closes by itself, and POOF - the shift happens again and a strange sort of "exhale feeling" happens (as if the room itself sighs in relief) - and our group would be back in the mansion again. I don't know when I started going here, but it was very young (around 8-9, maybe), and continued all through my teenage years until I got chased out (another story I won't get into here)... but I've heard a few other people say they visited a mansion quite often as a child while in the flipside, so... I wanted to see if this group is familiar with it as well - and what their mansions were like, if they can recall back that far. I still remember a few of the realms, too... it was a great way to explore the... UNIVERSE? I guess you could say, LOL... kinda hard to quantify the boundaries of where it was allowing us to go, TBH. But anyways... if you remember... do share! I've always wondered if I was inadvertently meeting these kids in real life, and not recognizing them... the faces are always 'scrambled' when I am awake, so I couldn't describe anyone in any sort of way. Kinda like I/we are not meant to remember. https://preview.redd.it/l7slxy20cw1d1.jpg?width=642&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=3f60528f4ef79fb4a4da6ac9c00dcd4d7398a6a6
